name: RevoluSun Solar
old_description: Locally owned and operated since 2009. We specialize in residential and commercial solar panel installation, Tesla Powerwall battery storage, Tesla Solar Roof, and EV charging.
about:
RevoluSun Solar is a locally owned and operated solar installation company headquartered in Boise, Idaho. The business traces its roots to a flagship location opened in Hawaii in 2009, before expanding to the Pacific Northwest with a Boise office in 2019 and a Coeur d’Alene office in 2022. The company serves all of Idaho, Washington, and Oregon from its Mountain States division.

The firm provides full-service solar and energy storage installation for residential and commercial customers. Its offerings include rooftop and ground-mounted solar panel systems, Tesla Solar Roof installations, battery storage using Tesla Powerwall, Sonnen, FranklinWH, and Enphase products, and EV charger installation with Tesla Wall Connector and SPAN Drive equipment. RevoluSun manages the entire process from energy assessment and system design through permitting, inspection, and utility interconnection. To date, the company has completed over 10,000 installations across the Pacific Northwest.

RevoluSun works with homeowners, businesses, and property owners seeking grid resilience and energy independence. Its residential clients include households adding solar, backup batteries, and EV charging, while commercial projects range from small businesses to larger facilities. The company’s project portfolio spans Idaho, eastern Washington, and Oregon, with installations tailored to the region’s climate and utility requirements.

The company emphasizes its Tesla Certified Energy Installer status and a design approach built for the Pacific Northwest’s specific weather and energy patterns. Its stated mission is “building the future of energy by taking care of people and always doing the right thing,” focusing on local expertise, durable products, and seamless project management.
